option_relations.rationale: Sepsis due to Capnocytophaga canimorsus infection is a broader clinical state where Capnocytophaga canimorsus infection is the underlying cause.
Immune thrombocytopenic purpura (ITP) is a distinct hematologic disorder not directly related to Capnocytophaga canimorsus infection.
Capnocytophaga canimorsus-induced immune thrombocytopenia describes a complication or specific manifestation that can arise from a Capnocytophaga canimorsus infection.
Capnocytophaga canimorsus sepsis is a broader clinical state where Capnocytophaga canimorsus infection is the underlying cause.
